build_adam_optimizer: build a PyTorch Adam optimizer with weight decay for training deep learning models
create_metaseqadam_config: create a MetaseqAdamConfig dataclass to configure Adam betas, epsilon, and weight decay
test_adam_step: test the Adam optimizer step method to perform a single optimization update on model parameters
review_metaseqadam_optimizer_config: review the MetaseqAdam optimizer_config property that returns lr, betas, eps, and weight_decay kwargs
refactor_adam_fp16_support: refactor the Adam optimizer to support FP16 and BF16 gradient and parameter data types
